reports.title: Anthony Preston
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Mr Preston had demonstrated, in his early return from home leave in the first few days of November, that living at home was a source of substantial stress, and likely to cause him severe anxiety and deepen his depression.
concerns.hazard: living at home causing severe anxiety and depression

concerns.quote: The system for discharge of patients, whereby a nurse makes contact with (in this case) the Leicestershire Crisis Team does not appear to have been robust. There was no documentary proof of the telephone call.
There was no immediate follow up by e mail or fax to the Crisis Team to notify the discharge, and the fact that Mr Preston was at high risk because of the anxiety created when he was living at home.
concerns.hazard: lack of immediate follow up to notify discharge

concerns.quote: As aresult, Mr Preston and his main carer | left without support at a time when he was at high risk
concerns.hazard: lack of support at high risk

links.explanation: Both reports highlight a lack of systematic follow‑up communication after a patient’s discharge or missed appointment. The earlier report cites absent systems to contact patients after missed visits, while the later report notes missing email/fax notification to the crisis team after discharge.
links.earlier_quote: There are no systems, either in private practice or in the Priory Hospital, Altrincham to contact patients following a failure to attend appointments
